title: WellNest Projects Look Deck
project: WellNest dashboard: new Projects section (carousel of 4 projects, expand in place to a rotatable render plus description)
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (sample project notes, .example domains).

pairs.ask: How do you move through the 4 projects?

optionA.label: Snap scroll
optionA.desc: Swipe sideways; each thumbnail snaps into place. The next one peeks in at the edge.
optionA.more: Feels native on phone; trackpad and shift-scroll on wide screens.

optionB.label: Arrows plus dots
optionB.desc: Left and right arrows with four dots underneath showing where you are.
optionB.more: Clear on wide screens; still swipeable on phone.

optionA.label: Square
optionA.more: Compact; more of the row fits.

optionB.label: Tall card
optionB.desc: Taller portrait cards, like a product poster.

pairs.ask: Where does the project name sit?

optionA.label: Under the thumbnail
optionA.desc: Name in Khand below the picture.

optionB.label: Overlaid
optionB.desc: Name on a soft dark fade at the bottom of the picture.

pairs.ask: What happens when you tap a thumbnail?

optionA.label: Inline expand
optionA.desc: The row stays; the tapped project opens in place below it.
optionA.more: You keep your place on the dashboard.

optionB.label: Full-screen overlay
optionB.desc: The project fills the screen over a dim backdrop, with a close X.

pairs.ask: How do you turn the product?

optionA.label: Drag to rotate
optionA.desc: Grab the render and drag; it turns with your finger or mouse.
optionA.more: A small hand hint shows once, then hides.

optionB.label: Angle buttons or slider
optionB.desc: Front, Side, Back, Top buttons, plus a slider to scrub the turn.
optionB.more: Exact angles; good for comparing labels.

pairs.ask: Does the product turn on its own when it opens?

optionA.label: Auto-spin on
optionA.desc: Slow turn until you touch it; stops for reduced-motion users.

optionB.label: Auto-spin off
optionB.desc: Opens still, front facing. You turn it when you want.

optionA.label: Beside the render
optionA.desc: Render on the left, what is in it, inspiration and status on the right. Stacks on phone.

optionA.label: Pill
optionA.desc: A small coloured pill: Idea, Planning, In design, Sampling.

optionB.label: Progress line
optionB.desc: A thin line from Idea to Launch, filled to where it is.

pairs.ask: How much shine on the cards?

optionA.label: Barely
optionA.desc: A hairline highlight on the top edge; you notice it only up close.

optionB.label: Soft glow
optionB.desc: A gentle warm glow and a slow sheen pass on hover.
optionB.more: A little more sparkle, still light.

pairs.ask: How does the Projects section start?

optionA.label: Khand title, terracotta bar
optionA.desc: "PROJECTS" in Khand caps with a short terracotta underline.

optionB.label: Title, count and leaf line
optionB.desc: "Projects · 4" with a full-width line and a small green leaf in the middle.

optionA.label: Cream
optionA.desc: Plain WellNest cream behind the product.

optionB.label: Soft gradient
optionB.desc: A soft lagoon-to-cream gradient, like studio light.
